{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Re-load the data
sales = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Check if any revenue value contains a comma
has_comma = sales['revenue'].str.contains(',', na=False)

# Count how many have commas
comma_count = has_comma.sum()
print(f"Number of revenue entries with commas: {comma_count}")

# Show a few examples if any
if comma_count > 0:
    print("Examples of revenue values with commas:")
    print(sales.loc[has_comma, 'revenue'].unique()[:5])"}
